event.title: FDA assessment of storm damage at Pfizer Rocky Mount facility
event.location: Rocky Mount, North Carolina, United States
event.established: FDA reported storm damage at the facility and ongoing assessment of affected products and supply on July 21, 2023.
event.uncertain_implications: FDA did not expect immediate significant supply impacts. This statement does not identify affected carboplatin products, shipment delays, supplier links or hospital dependencies; event date denotes the dated FDA assessment, not an inferred shutdown date.
